sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Urban Electric Cargo Bicycles and Step-Through Scooters

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (FTA; in force since 31 October 2012)
Panama–United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 10 May 1991)
Panama–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1985)
Panama–France Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force since 1982)
Panama–United States Tax Information Exchange Agreement (in force since 1 January 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 32 of 26 February 1927 (General Corporation Law) and the Código de Comercio govern corporate formation. AML/CFT governance: Ley No. 23 of 27 April 2015 (AML/CFT/CPF), as amended, including by Ley No. 254 of 2023; Ley No. 52 of 2016 (mandatory registered shares and immobilization of bearer shares); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 246 of 2020 (customer due diligence, risk classification, and beneficial ownership reporting); and the binding regulations and resolutions of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF), the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá, and the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI/ANIP) for the Final Beneficiaries Register.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: the Final Beneficiaries Register is confidential and not publicly searchable. Access is granted on a statutory basis to the DGI/ANIP, the UAF, tax and criminal justice authorities, and to obliged entities solely for AML/CFT due-diligence purposes; nominee names may appear in the corporate share register, but the UBO register must ultimately identify the controlling natural persons.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder) authorizing the resident agent and counsel to incorporate the Sociedad Anónima and execute all filing instruments
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin (for foreign grantors) or a Panamanian Notario Público (for execution in Panama)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the 1961 Convention (Panama party since 1991); where the origin country is not a Hague member, Panamanian Consular Legalization is required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarized copy of the biometric passport page of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner and first director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary or civil registry authority of the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR consular legalization at a Consulate of Panama (for non-Hague jurisdictions)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (General Law on Corporations, Sociedad Anónima), as amended by Ley 5 de 2013; applicable provisions include Articles 1, 5-10 (formation, corporate name, and authorized capital), Article 26 (obligation to appoint a resident agent), and Articles 33-41 (directors, officers, and corporate governance).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) recorded as the Certificado de Registro / Ficha
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorized capital is customarily USD 10,000 divided into 100 registered shares of USD 100 each, with at least one share subscribed at incorporation; no escrow or proof-of-disbursement requirement is imposed by the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: FIRST, that the authorized capital of USD 10,000, divided into 100 registered common shares of USD 100 each, be subscribed and issued to the founding shareholders as recorded in Share Register No. 1. SECOND, that the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the Resident Agent, [Resident Agent Name], [Registered Address], Panama City, Republic of Panama. THIRD, that [Name] be and hereby is appointed President and Chief Executive Officer, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each to hold office until the next Annual General Meeting. FOURTH, that the appointed officers are jointly authorized to execute the public registry filings, open bank accounts, and complete all fiscal and municipal registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Dirección de Búsqueda de Nombres (online portal: www.registropublico.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre listing at least three proposed corporate names in priority order. The Public Registry searches the mercantile index and issues a Certificado de Búsqueda (name clearance certificate) valid for 30 days. The approved certificate must be attached to the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Application letter countersigned by the Resident Agent or incorporating attorney
Three proposed corporate names in order of preference
Payment receipt for the name search fee (approx. USD 30 per name)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected for similarity to an existing entity, the registry issues a negative search result; immediately substitute the next available candidate name and refile the application the same day at no additional fee beyond the original search charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público (Notary Public) of the Republic of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the corporate charter, broad object clause covering manufacture of electric cargo bicycles and step-through scooters, authorized capital, resident agent appointment, and first directors. The incorporators, or their attorney-in-fact under a Poder, must appear before a Panamanian notary to execute the deed and affix the required stamp taxes.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation / corporate by-laws (Estatutos)
Certificado de Búsqueda (name clearance certificate)
Notarized Power of Attorney (Poder) if incorporators are not physically present
Valid passport or cédula of each incorporator and director
Evidence of payment of notarial fees and stamp taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any notarial defect is cured by executing a clarifying deed (Escritura de Aclaración) before the same notary prior to registry presentation; pre-validating the draft against the Public Registry checklist avoids most re-executions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Deed with the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized testimonio of the Escritura Pública together with the registry forms and payment of official treasury and registration fees. Upon successful inscription, the registry issues the Ficha (corporate card) and Certificado de Registro, which legally evidences the juridical personality of the Sociedad Anónima.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución (testimonio)
Certificado de Búsqueda (name clearance certificate)
Registry fee payment receipt (Formulario CAIP)
Identification documents and address of the Resident Agent
List of subscribers and first directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues an observación (query or defect), the applicant has 10 business days to file a subsanación with corrected documents or an aclaración; failure to cure within 30 days voids the inscription and requires refiling with new fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration - RUC and NIT at the Revenue Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain certified copies of the Ficha and Certificado de Registro from the Public Registry, then register the S.A. through the DGI online RUC portal or in person. Declare the economic activity under CIIU 3091 (manufacture of transport equipment for urban micro-mobility), and obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes), NIT number, and electronic invoicing authorization (facturación).
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the registered Escritura Pública de Constitución
Ficha and Certificado de Registro issued by the Public Registry
Identification document of the legal representative
Completed RUC application form (Formulario 1)
Lease agreement or deed evidencing the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is queried for mismatched economic activity or address, correct the declared CIIU code or submit a revised lease/address proof electronically; coordinate with the Resident Agent to align the registered office documentation before refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Aviso de Operación and Commercial Patent License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá - Sección de Aviso de Operación / Tesorería Municipal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Aviso de Operación application declaring the e-bike manufacturing activity at the plant address. Attach the fire safety certificate, environmental compliance registration, and zoning certificate. Upon approval, pay the proportionate municipal patent fee (Patente Municipal) and receive the annual Aviso de Operación permitting commercial operation within the district.
required_dossiers: RUC and NIT certificate
Certified copy of the registered incorporation deed
Lease or property title for the manufacturing facility
Certificado de Uso de Suelo (zoning certificate) issued by the Municipality
Dictamen of the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (fire safety clearance)
MiAMBIENTE environmental compliance registration certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality issues a requerimiento for insufficient zoning or safety documentation, cure the objection by obtaining the missing certificates (Uso de Suelo or Bomberos inspection) and resubmitting within the 15-business-day procedural deadline; provisional operation is not permitted until the Aviso is issued.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipio de Panamá - Dirección de Aviso de Operación (municipal industrial licensing office), with technical classification and trade facilitation support from the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación y Patente Municipal (Municipal Business Operation and Commercial Patent License) for Manufacturing Establishment

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección Nacional de Evaluación y Cumplimiento Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I - Environmental Compliance Registration (Registro de Cumplimiento Ambiental) filed through the MiAMBIENTE VUPA online system; a full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EIA/EsIA) is not required for standard e-bike assembly operations; the registration must be renewed annually and the certificate displayed at the facility.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from battery-cooling, floor washing, and cleaning processes must meet Panamanian industrial discharge limits (BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 200 mg/L, TSS ≤ 100 mg/L, pH 6.0-9.0, oil and grease ≤ 20 mg/L) with quarterly monitoring; painting and adhesive stations must comply with national ambient air quality regulations and workplace VOC exposure limits of 50 ppm (8-hour TWA) per MINSA/MITRADEL occupational hygiene rules; hazardous wastes from lithium-ion battery handling must be stored in labeled leak-proof containers and shipped to a MiAMBIENTE-authorized waste operator with a proper manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá: obtain the Dictamen de Seguridad, Prevención y Protección contra Incendios covering fire exits, extinguishers, and structural load verification of the plant before start-up; Ministerio de Salud (MINSA): secure the Licencia Sanitaria de Funcionamiento for industrial premises, including sanitation of painting and charging areas; Municipality Engineering Department: perform structural load inspection and confirm building code compliance; Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL): register employees and comply with occupational health and safety program obligations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de Panamá; electronic portal: Sede Electrónica (sede-electronica.dgi.gob.pa).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must: (i) engage a resident attorney and file organizational documents with the Registro Público de Panamá; (ii) obtain Aviso de Operación if conducting activities requiring a municipal business license; (iii) apply for RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) through DGI Sede Electrónica by submitting corporate identification, resident-agent proof, registered office credentials, and authenticated powers of attorney; (iv) complete the DGI registration forms to activate ITBMS and income-tax obligations. A non-resident company without a permanent establishment may obtain a non-resident RUC only if it derives Panama-source income; failure to register before commencement of taxable activity attracts fines under the Código Fiscal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election exists under Panamanian corporate law. Foreign entities may elect to operate as a registered branch ('sucursal') or form a local Sociedad Anónima (S.A.). Under Law 41 of 2007, a qualifying multinational headquarters (SEM) may elect a reduced 10% income tax rate and special ITBMS treatment for covered headquarters services. Domestic taxpayer classification remains territorial: Panama-source income is taxed at 25%, foreign-source income is excluded. No statutory anti-hybrid election regime applies, though transfer-pricing documentation and substance requirements must be respected.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (ITBMS – Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary turnover threshold – ITBMS registration (via RUC) is mandatory for every person or entity performing taxable transfers of movable goods or services in Panama, irrespective of volume. A simplified 'Pequeño Contribuyente' fixed-payment regime may apply to small taxpayers with annual gross receipts up to B/. 200,000 (Balboas / USD).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory. DGI Sede Electrónica operates the 'Facturación Electrónica en Línea' platform. Taxpayers must use DGI-authorized invoicing software that transmits documents to the DGI in real time, or use DGI's virtual invoicing web service. Invoices must include a unique validation code and QR fiscal stamp; suppliers must implement the DGI-approved API / web-service integration. Non-conforming invoices are not valid for ITBMS credit or expense deduction.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating is available for tangible goods physically exported from Panama when the exporter maintains proof of departure from the national customs territory. Panama-source services are zero-rated when the recipient is outside Panama and the service is economically used or consumed exclusively outside Panamanian territory; typical examples include offshore software/services, cargo transport ancillary services, and repair services on exported goods. Sales to Zona Libre de Colón are exempt from ITBMS if re-export is documented and completed within the free-trade zone regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUCA / DUS – submitted through ANA's SICA system)
Bill of Lading (ocean, air, or land transport evidence)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Remesa / SWIFT credit advice showing FX repatriation)
Sales Contract or Purchase Order demonstrating economic substance and end-recipient identity
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and the National Customs Authority (ANA) jointly audit export transactions. The DGI has access to customs declarations, banking records, and electronic invoicing data. Unsupported or fraudulent zero-rating triggers immediate clawback of input VAT credits previously claimed, plus a surcharge of 10% per annum on the omitted tax and fines ranging from 10% to 200% of the tax due under Código Fiscal. Criminal liability may include disqualification of the legal representative, business closure, and imprisonment for up to six years for tax fraud under Law 38 of 2003.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No dedicated central bank; Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent for the Republic of Panama; regulation of licensed banks is undertaken by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP). The United States dollar circulates as legal tender under a full dollarization regime, with the Panamanian balboa issued only as fractional coins.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama applies a full dollarization system, and both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible with no exchange controls or central-bank approval requirements. There is no mandatory conversion into a local paper currency. Profit remittance abroad is legally unrestricted; the only treasury-level hurdle is the 10% dividend tax levied on distributions of Panamanian-source profits, which is withheld and settled by the paying entity. No additional FX convertibility barrier or repatriation permit applies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender rules exist. Panamanian exporters are permitted to retain 100% of their USD proceeds in local bank accounts without any mandatory conversion, holding timeline, or repatriation requirement. The only compliance duty is the general AML framework, under which covered customers and transactions must be reported to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) when applicable thresholds are breached.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate — offshore digital EMIs and payment platforms may serve as supplementary collection/disbursement rails, but they cannot replace a licensed Panamanian banking relationship. Panama has no standalone EMI licensing law; virtual IBANs and payment accounts are only offered through partnership with licensed banks or under the International Banking Center umbrella. Legal constraints include compliance with Law 23 of 2015, the AML/CFT antinominal regime administered by the UAF, and the practical requirement for local correspondent bank settlement. For this low-risk manufacturing entity, an EMI may be viable for supplier payments and receivable collection, but its use should be restricted to secondary rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a non-resident-owned Panama S.A., most tier-1 banks require at least one authorized director, legal representative, or designated company officer to attend an in-person KYC interview at a Panamanian branch or regional business center. Remote account opening is not a statutory right; some banks accept remote onboarding for low-risk corporates when notarized and apostilled corporate documents are presented, and when a video-verified interview is combined with independent source-of-funds checks. Physical presence remains the practical baseline for a newly formed entity with no prior banking history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A sworn UBO declaration, proof of beneficial ownership chain, notarized passport copies, certified corporate registers, opening balance sheet or audited financial statements, source-of-funds affidavit, and prior bank reference letters.

Current share register, bearer-share immobilization certificate, legal opinion confirming that no dormant bearer shares remain, apostilled board resolution, and the company secretary's certificate of good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Import transactions routed through high-risk trade corridors or sanctioned jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pro-forma and final supplier invoices, bills of lading/airway bills, customs entry declarations, Sanctions/PEP screening reports, end-user certificates, shipping route documentation, and a written supply-chain compliance policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity USD account turnover without local operational substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Operational lease agreement for Panamanian premises or co-working office, local payroll documentation if applicable, budgeted cash-flow projections, OEM purchase orders, sales contracts, and a detailed treasury forecast explaining expected wire velocity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder-loan capital should be routed by SWIFT MT103 wire from the investor's bank to the Panama S.A. USD operational or capital escrow account at a licensed Panamanian bank. The wire must include the exact beneficiary name and account number, a purpose string such as 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION', 'EQUITY INJECTION', or 'SHAREHOLDER SUBORDINATED LOAN', and be preceded by a board/shareholder resolution authorizing the contribution and identifying the contributing party. For wires above USD 10,000, the receiving bank may request the injector's KYC file, source-of-funds evidence, and an updated corporate extract. No central-bank approval or exchange permit is required because the US dollar is legal tender and Panama imposes no capital controls.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for imported components and production machinery can be executed through SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for advance payments, open-account settlements, or under an irrevocable documentary commercial letter of credit (L/C) issued by a Panamanian commercial bank and confirmed through a US or Asian correspondent bank. USD payments clear over the US correspondent network (typically CHIPS or Fedwire) and remain inside the US clearing zone, while CNY, EUR, NTD, or KRW payments require a market-rate FX conversion executed by the remitting bank or a treasury specialist. The underlying transaction must be evidenced by pro-forma invoices, purchase orders, and shipping documentation to satisfy the issuing/remitting bank's CDD and sanctions review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright forwards or deliverable FX forwards in EUR, CNY, NTD, KRW, and other trade-partner currencies executed via licensed Panamanian or international banking center counterparties
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-fully-convertible currencies (e.g., CNY or KRW) settled in USD
Cross-currency swaps for medium-term financing or supplier-credit exposures
FX swaps and FX options for managing short- to medium-term transactional exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Matrícula)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 15 January; no extension available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Two-month grace period; if unpaid, an additional fine of B/.300.00 is imposed. Continued default for one year authorizes the DGI to list the corporation as 'morosa', block issuance of tax clearance, and initiate administrative strike-off after formal notices.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Aviso de Operación Renewal (Business Operating License)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipalidad del Distrito de Panamá (or relevant local municipality of the manufacturing establishment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March, following the municipal tax calendar; deadlines may vary by district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment subjects the company to a 10% surcharge plus cumulative monthly interest. Non-renewal of the Aviso de Operación enables municipal inspectors to seal the premises and impose fines up to B/.500.00 per non-compliant period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta – Formulario 202)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – SEDE Electronic Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 15 March for calendar-year corporations; for off-calendar fiscal years, within three months after year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty ranges from 5% to 25% of the assessed tax, with interest payable at the DGI's monthly statutory rate. Failure to file for two months places the company on the public default register and prevents obtaining a Paz y Salvo for operational permits and banking transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Declaration (Declaración de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – SEDE Electronic Platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March; any transfer of shares, change of beneficial owner, or change of resident agent must be reported within 30 calendar days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file timely attracts fines of B/.500.00 to B/.5,000.00 per violation. Incorrect or sworn-beneficiary declarations can render the corporation administratively compliant and subject the resident agent to liability under Panamanian AML regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements (Estados Financieros Auditados) – filed with corporate minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting and statutory corporate books; submitted to DGI upon inspection request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end if the mandatory audit threshold is exceeded; otherwise kept at registered office for DGI inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the DGI requests audited statements during an on-site examination and the company fails to produce them, fines of B/.1,000.00 to B/.5,000.00 may be imposed, and disallowed deductions can be permanently denied.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent CPA audit is mandatory for a Panama corporation when gross annual revenues exceed USD 3,000,000, total assets exceed USD 5,000,000, or when the entity is licensed by the Superintendencia de Mercado de Valores (SUMEVAL) or the Banking Superintendence. Below these thresholds, shareholders may appoint a 'Comisario' and waive a full external audit by unanimous resolution.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panamanian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF/IFRS as adopted by the Asociación Panameña de Auditores) and applicable DGI tax accounting rules; the U.S. dollar is the legal functional currency for statutory bookkeeping.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 70 of 2019 and Executive Decree 129 of 2020, every Panama Sociedad Anónima must maintain a Register of Final Beneficiaries at the registered agent's office and submit an annual sworn declaration through the DGI's SEDE platform by March 31. The confirmation must identify all direct and indirect shareholders, any share transfer that occurred during the year, and the ultimate natural-person beneficial owners. Changes to the register must be updated within 30 calendar days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax on net taxable income derived from Panamanian sources (Código Fiscal art. 733, as reformed by Law 8 of 2010).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation model: income from foreign sources (foreign dividends, foreign interest, offshore trading profits) is exempt at 0%. No general income tax holiday for standard manufacturing. A qualified export e-bike manufacturer may access: (i) the drawback and temporary importation customs regime for imported components; (ii) the Panama Pacifico Special Economic Area regime (Law 41 of 2004) granting 100% income tax and ITBMS exemptions for qualified activities; (iii) the SEM Multinational Headquarters regime (Law 41 of 2007) at a reduced effective rate if treasury, logistics, and shared services for the foreign group are added; (iv) the 5% dividend withholding rate on distributions from taxed earnings, versus 10% on distributions from untaxed or exempt earnings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 201 (Declaración Jurada de Renta) filed exclusively through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) electronic portal 'e-Tax 2.0' at dgi.mef.gob.pa, authenticated with the digital signature of the legal representative and the registered public accountant.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (fiscal year equivalent to the calendar year unless a different period is authorized by the DGI).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before March 31 of the year immediately following the fiscal year-end; the deadline is not extended by postponements of the shareholders' meeting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), corporate name as registered at the Public Registry, fiscal address, and resident agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The NIT must correspond to the Panamanian S.A.; the foreign beneficial owner is not reported in this box. The resident agent (agente residente) and the designated legal representative must be active and licensed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from Panamanian-source activity: domestic and exported sales of electric cargo e-bikes manufactured in Panama, spare parts sales, battery leasing, and maintenance service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export sales FOB Panama are Panamanian-source and must be declared. Do not net production costs or freight charges; gross amounts from the sales ledger must reconcile with financial statements and customs export declarations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exemption block for income generated outside Panama (e.g., dividends received from a foreign sales subsidiary, interest on offshore deposits).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: To claim the exemption the taxpayer bears the burden of proof. Maintain a separate bank account, contract files, and a memorandum identifying the foreign source. Misclassification to avoid Panamanian tax constitutes evasion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs: cost of goods sold (raw materials, batteries, imported motors), factory payroll, rent, utilities, depreciation of production machinery, transfer-pricing-adjusted intercompany purchase costs, and technical service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses attributable to foreign-source income are not deductible. Intercompany component purchases must be priced at arm's length and supported by invoices and a Form 250 reference. All invoices must meet ITBMS (7% VAT) documentary validity rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating losses brought forward: maximum carryforward of 5 years; no carryback is permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify that no transfer-pricing adjustment has retroactively reduced the loss pool. Losses arising in years with related-party transactions are vulnerable to DGI disallowance if Form 250/local file documentation was not prepared.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after deductions and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The DGI may recalculate this figure if the transfer-pricing documentation is absent or incomplete.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Headline corporate income tax calculated at 25% of Box 871.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be made in Balboas/USD to the Tesorería General de la República through the DGI portal. Foreign exchange gains or losses are recognized when realized in the Panamanian books.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax due after crediting withholdings (Box 886) and advance payments (Box 887), including the 2% minimum advance on gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 2% minimum advance paid on Form 194 is creditable; any shortfall accrues 1% monthly interest and the 10% late-filing surcharge. Foreign-parent expense allocations cannot reduce the minimum advance below the statutory floor.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: surcharge of 10% of the tax due plus an additional 1% per month (or fraction thereof) up to 20% of the tax, and interest at 1% per month on the unpaid amount. Non-filing empowers the DGI to assess ex officio on estimated income with an uplift of up to 40% of the omitted tax, plus fines between PAB 500 and PAB 10,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 250 (Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia) filed via the same DGI e-Tax 2.0 portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before March 31 of the year following the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Identificación del Contribuyente y Partes Relacionadas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party registry: foreign parent, distribution affiliates, component suppliers, and permanent establishments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all foreign related entities, indicating jurisdiction, tax residence certificate status, and the functional profile of each counterparty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of intercompany transactions broken down by category: exports of goods, imports of raw materials, intangibles, services, and financial transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export sales of e-bikes to the related foreign distributor and imports of motors/batteries from the parent must be reported at contractual values, reconciled to customs declarations and the general ledger.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Método de Precios de Transferencia Aplicado
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection and justification of the arm's length method per transaction category.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CUP is appropriate for commodity components; TNMM is typically applied to the Panamanian contract manufacturer using net margins derived from independent comparable companies. Mark the method codes exactly as prescribed by the DGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Rango Intercuartil y Ajuste de Comparabilidad
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Comparability analysis showing the arm's length range and any year-end adjustment made by the taxpayer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the realized margin falls outside the interquartile range, a voluntary adjustment must be recorded in the same filing with corresponding accrual of interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file Form 250 or filing with material omissions: fines of PAB 1,000 to PAB 10,000 per violation; failure to maintain Local/Master File: comparable fines. Any DGI transfer-pricing adjustment carries a 20% deficiency surcharge on the understated tax plus 1% monthly interest.
